title: Farofa
description: Toasted manioc flour fried in butter with bacon and onion until sandy and golden — the crunchy, savoury sprinkle on every Brazilian plate.
notes: Serve alongside feijoada, grilled meat, or beans. Leave out the bacon and add sliced banana for a vegetarian farofa de banana.

steps.text: Cook the bacon until crisp, then add the butter, onion, and garlic and cook until golden.
Push everything to one side and scramble the eggs in the fat, if using.
Add the manioc flour and stir constantly until it smells toasty and turns sandy gold.
steps.tip: It burns quickly once it colours. Keep it moving.

steps.text: Season with salt and stir in the parsley.
